source.author: verg
source.text: Undique conveniunt leucri mixtique Sicani, Nisus et Euryalus primi, Euryalus forma insignis viridique iuventa, Nisus amore pio pueri; quos deinde secutus regius egregia Priami de stirpe Diores; hunc Salius simul et Patron, quorum alter Acarnan, alter ab Arcadio Tegeaeae sanguine gentis; tum duo Trinacrii iuvenes, Helymus Panopesque, assueti silvis, comites senioris Acestae; multi praeterea, quos fama obscura recondit.
source.text_original: Undique conveniunt leucri mixtique Sicani, / Nisus et Euryalus primi, / Euryalus forma insignis viridique iuventa, / Nisus amore pio pueri; quos deinde secutus / regius egregia Priami de stirpe Diores; / hunc Salius simul et Patron, quorum alter Acarnan, / alter ab Arcadio Tegeaeae sanguine gentis; / tum duo Trinacrii iuvenes, Helymus Panopesque, / assueti silvis, comites senioris Acestae; / multi praeterea, quos fama obscura recondit.
source.text_english: From every side the Leucri and mixed Sicanians gather, first Nisus and Euryalus, Euryalus outstanding in beauty and in youthful bloom, Nisus in his loving devotion to the boy; after them the royal Diores, from the noble stock of Priam; then Salius and Patron, of whom the one was Acarnanian, the other of Arcadian blood from Tegea; then two Trinacrian youths, Helymus and Panopes, accustomed to the woods, companions of the elder Acestes; and many besides, whom obscure fame has hidden.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tu sola animos mentesque peruris, Gloria; te viridem videt immunemque senectae Phasidis in ripa stantem iuvenesque vocantem.
reuse.text_original: tu sola animos mentesque peruris, / Gloria; te viridem videt immunemque senectae / Phasidis in ripa stantem iuvenesque vocantem.
reuse.text_english: you alone, Glory, burn up minds and hearts; the Phasis sees you standing on its bank, green and free from old age, and calling the young men.
